description: Use when enabling, configuring, or querying Salesforce field history tracking to audit changes to field values over time. Covers enabling tracking on objects and fields, the 20-field-per-object limit, 18-month data retention, querying standard History sObjects (AccountHistory, OpportunityFieldHistory, custom __History), and troubleshooting missing records. NOT for Shield Field Audit Trail, FieldHistoryArchive, or keeping history past 18 months — use security/field-audit-trail. NOT for CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate, or SystemModstamp behavior — use admin/system-field-behavior-and-audit.
inputs: Name of the object(s) requiring field history (standard or custom)
List of fields to track on each object
Retention requirement in months (standard tracking covers up to 18 months in the UI and 24 via the API)
Query scope: specific record, user, date range, or field
name: field-history-tracking
official_sources: Security Implementation Guide 262 L4553-4556, L4632-4635 (18/24-month retention, no storage charge), L4653-4657 and L4687-4689 (considerations), L4774-4803 (20-field limit, ineligible fields), L4836-4838 and L4881-4897 (Field Audit Trail, retention policy default, delete cascade). Cite as `secguide 262`.

Object Reference 264 L4604-4660 (StandardObjectNameHistory fields), L195716-195781 (OpportunityFieldHistory) and L195800-195926 (OpportunityHistory); Metadata API 264 L44320-44323 (`enableHistory`), L45893-45898 (`trackHistory`), L46329-46332 (`archiveAfterMonths` 1-18).

Salesforce SOQL and SOSL Reference — Using Relationship Queries with History Objects: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.soql_sosl.meta/soql_sosl/sforce_api_calls_soql_relationships_query_hist.htm

Salesforce Object Reference — StandardObjectNameHistory (associated history objects): https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_associated_objects_history.htm

Salesforce Field Audit Trail Implementation Guide — SOQL with the FieldHistoryArchive Object: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.field_history_retention.meta/field_history_retention/field_history_soql.htm
outputs: Field History Tracking enablement decisions per object and field
SOQL query patterns for XxxHistory and custom __History objects
Troubleshooting diagnosis for missing history records
Decision guidance on when to extend to Shield Field Audit Trail
Configuration checklist for enablement and review
